Tidy tables from an event graph

Source: R/event-graph.R
as.data.frame.dynet_event_graph.Rd

Tidy tables from an event graph

Usage

# S3 method for class 'dynet_event_graph'
as.data.frame(
  x,
  row.names = NULL,
  optional = FALSE,
  what = c("events", "adjacencies"),
  ...
)

Arguments

x

An event graph returned by event_graph().

row.names

Ignored; present for compatibility with the generic.

optional

Ignored; present for compatibility with the generic.

what

"events", the default, returns one row per event; "adjacencies" returns one row per arc and shared vertex.

...

Ignored.

Value

A plain data frame; the columns are listed under event_graph().

Examples

dn <- dynet(school_contacts)
eg <- event_graph(dn, delta = 1)
as.data.frame(eg)
